abstract: How individuals make trade‐offs between socially proximate or distant groups impacts upon a wide range of social, political and economic behaviours. This paper exploits Norwegian administrative register data over the 2012–2022 period to assess whether, and if so how, such ‘(moral) universalism’ develops as individuals age and go through major life events. We show that ageing is associated with increases in universalism in early adulthood and declining universalism among older individuals, but the magnitude of these changes remains very small. Similarly, major life events—such as starting higher education, first‐time parenthood, positive income shocks and retirement—are linked to at best minor and short‐lived changes in universalism. These results add important insights regarding the (in)stability of individuals' value orientations during adulthood, and raise new questions about the potential influence of broader social forces on universalism across cohorts.
abstract_zh: 个体如何在社交亲近或疏远群体之间进行权衡，会影响广泛的社会、政治和经济行为。本文利用挪威2012-2022年期间的行政登记数据，评估这种“（道德）普遍主义”是否会随年龄增长及经历重大人生事件而发生变化，以及如何变化。我们发现，年龄增长与成年早期普遍主义的上升及老年个体普遍主义的下降相关，但这些变化的幅度非常微小。同样，重大人生事件——如开始接受高等教育、首次成为父母、正向收入冲击及退休——最多仅与普遍主义的微小且短暂变化相关。这些结果为了解成年期个体价值取向的（不）稳定性提供了重要见解，并引发了关于更广泛社会力量对不同世代普遍主义潜在影响的新问题。
title: Universalism: an 11‐year longitudinal study
title_zh: 普遍主义：一项11年纵向研究

abstract: This Working Paper presents findings from an assessment of farm commercialization and farm services during the 2025 monsoon. The analysis is based on data from the Myanmar Agriculture Performance Survey (MAPS), a phone-based survey conducted with 4, 553 crop farmers across all states/regions of the country during Q1 of 2026. Our findings reveal the following: Insecurity continues to affect farming, as reflected in the substantial share of farmers who feel unsafe and report being unable to move freely to buy inputs or sell outputs without serious concerns for their safety. Twenty-three percent of farmers reported feeling “very insecure” or “insecure” during the survey period. Additionally, 7 percent reported that some agricultural fields in their area could not be cultivated due to conflict. Furthermore, 9 percent of farmers expressed fear of storing produce at home because of the risk of confiscation or destruction. Despite challenges related to fuel and mobility, agricultural inputs were largely available during the monsoon, reflecting the resilience of the private sector in supplying these goods even under difficult conditions. However, labor scarcity is becoming more pronounced, seemingly linked to migration and insecurity. Input prices continued to rise, with fertilizer prices increasing by 24 percent compared to two years earlier. Other input costs, including mechanization and wages, increased even more. On the output side, prices for paddy—grown by 64 percent of all farmers during the monsoon—fell over the last two years, leading to reduced investments and lower agricultural productivity. Other crops linked to export markets also experienced price declines or only moderate increases over the same period, including pigeon pea (-18 percent) and maize (+28 percent), compared to much larger increases for more domestically consumed crops such as tomato (+178 percent), betel nut (+75 percent), and betel leaves (+43 percent). Most farmers reported either stabilization or worsening of agricultural sales income compared to the previous monsoon. Thirty-nine percent of farmers reported lower incomes in the 2025 monsoon season than in the previous monsoon, with 22 percent experiencing declines of more than 20 percent. Only 30 percent reported an increase in sales income. The use of agricultural credit during the 2025 monsoon continued its decline, falling from 47 percent of farmers in 2021 to 38 percent in 2025—a decrease of 9 percentage points. This decline occurred across all agro-ecological zones except the Delta. Access to agricultural extension services remained at levels similar to previous years, with 35 percent of farmers accessing some type of extension service. Security challenges continue to hinder crop commercialization in Myanmar. Conditions vary across states and regions, with the Delta—the country’s rice bowl—experiencing relatively better security conditions. Farmers in conflict-affected areas face greater obstacles to commercialization, including reduced availability of agricultural inputs.
abstract_zh: 本工作报告呈现了2025年季风季农业商业化与农业服务评估结果。分析基于2026年第一季度对全国各省邦4553名农作物种植者开展的缅甸农业绩效调查（MAPS）电话访谈数据。主要发现如下：安全局势持续影响农业生产，表现为相当比例的农户感到不安全，且报告称无法在无需严重担忧人身安全的情况下自由购买投入品或销售产品。调查期间，23%的农户表示感到"非常不安全"或"不安全"。此外，7%的农户报告其所在地区部分农田因冲突无法耕种。另有9%的农户因担心农产品被没收或损毁而不敢将收成储存在家中。尽管面临燃料与出行挑战，季风季农业投入品供应基本充足，反映出私营部门在困难条件下仍能维持物资供应的韧性。然而，劳动力短缺问题日益突出，似乎与人口迁移及安全局势相关。投入品价格持续上涨，化肥价格较两年前上涨24%。包括机械化与工资在内的其他投入成本涨幅更大。产出方面，占季风季种植农户64%的水稻价格在过去两年间下跌，导致投资减少与农业生产力下降。其他与出口市场相关的作物同期价格亦出现下跌或仅温和上涨，包括木豆（-18%）和玉米（+28%），而以内需为主的作物价格涨幅显著，如番茄（+178%）、槟榔（+75%）和蒌叶（+43%）。多数农户报告农业销售收入较上一季风季持平或恶化。39%的农户表示2025年季风季收入低于上一季风季，其中22%降幅超过20%。仅30%的农户报告销售收入增长。2025年季风季农业信贷使用率持续下降，从2021年的47%降至2025年的38%，降幅达9个百分点。除三角洲地区外，所有农业生态区均出现下降。农业推广服务获取率与往年持平，35%的农户获得某种形式的推广服务。安全挑战持续阻碍缅甸农作物商业化进程。各省邦情况存在差异，作为国家粮仓的三角洲地区安全状况相对较好。受冲突影响地区的农户在商业化过程中面临更大障碍，包括农业投入品供应减少。

abstract: ABSTRACT High‐stakes exams can be used to rank and select candidates for job openings, and the ability of those selected hinges on the design of the exam. I propose a method to model candidates' performance to assess how effective the exam is at selecting high‐ability candidates. I showcase this method with the competitive exam of the Bank of Italy. This is also an interesting case to study discrimination, as women are selected with a lower probability than men. The results suggest that the exam tends to select those candidates with a higher ability level. Finally, some simulations show how certain modifications to the exam structure could potentially enhance the selection process by increasing the average ability of the selected candidates.
journal: Oxford Bulletin of Economics and Statistics
title: Assessing the Effectiveness of Workers' Selection Exams: The Case of the Bank of Italy
title_zh: 评估工人选拔考试的有效性：以意大利银行为例

abstract: Background and Aims: Blind boxes are physical gambling-like products that consumers buy to receive random prizes, often only with a small chance of obtaining a specific product they desire. These products became globally popular in 2025 and are currently not legally regulated as a form of gambling, so children can buy them. Stakeholders are concerned about potential risks, including overspending and gambling-related harm. China is the first and only country to publish dedicated blind box regulatory policy, requiring age restrictions and transparency. Children under 8 are not allowed to buy blind boxes, and minors aged between 8 and 17 must have parental consent for purchasing. The probabilities of obtaining different random prizes must be disclosed. We assessed whether these policies have been duly implemented on the physical packaging of blind boxes manufactured and sold in China. Design: We conveniently purchased a diverse range of 50 blind boxes, including both well-known brands and lesser-known products. We then analysed all information shown on the physical packaging to identify compliance-related elements. Setting: Shenzhen, China Cases: 50 physical blind boxes purchased in November 2025. Measurements: The presence of age restriction information, parental consent requirement, and probability disclosures, and the visual prominence of probability disclosures. Findings: All products (100%) stated that they are not suitable for young children under 8, but 40% failed to also highlight the parental consent requirement for older children aged between 8 and 17. Probabilities were disclosed accurately and completely by 32% of blind boxes, whilst another 48% provided rounded up but still reasonably accurate and complete disclosures, so only 20% failed to disclose sufficiently or at all. The majority (66%) of blind boxes’ disclosed probabilities reasonably visually prominently, but a minority hid relevant information on multiple sides of the packaging (12%) or within a block of descriptive text (8%), making them harder for consumers to find. Conclusions: We observed relatively high compliance with Chinese blind box regulations, in terms of age restrictions and probabilistic transparency, although further improvements are required, particularly in relation to the parental consent requirement for older children and the visual prominence of probability disclosures.
abstract_zh: 背景与目的：盲盒是一种类似赌博的实体产品，消费者购买后随机获得奖品，通常只有极小概率能抽到心仪商品。这类产品于2025年在全球流行，目前尚未被法律界定为赌博形式，因此儿童可以购买。利益相关方担忧其潜在风险，包括过度消费和赌博相关危害。中国是首个也是唯一发布专门盲盒监管政策的国家，要求实施年龄限制和信息透明。8岁以下儿童禁止购买盲盒，8至17岁未成年人购买需经家长同意，且必须公开不同随机奖品的获取概率。本研究评估了这些政策是否在中国制造和销售的盲盒实体包装上得到有效落实。 设计：我们便利购买了50个涵盖知名品牌与冷门产品的多样化盲盒，随后分析实体包装上所有信息以识别合规相关要素。 场景：中国深圳 案例：2025年11月购买的50个实体盲盒。 测量指标：年龄限制信息、家长同意要求、概率披露的呈现情况，以及概率披露的视觉显著性。 发现：所有产品（100%）均标注“不适用于8岁以下幼童”，但40%未同时强调8至17岁儿童需家长同意的要求。32%的盲盒准确完整披露了概率，另有48%提供了四舍五入但依然合理准确的完整披露，仅20%未充分披露或完全未披露。大多数盲盒（66%）的概率披露在视觉上具有合理显著性，但少数产品将相关信息隐藏在包装多个侧面（12%）或描述性文本段落中（8%），增加了消费者查找难度。 结论：在年龄限制和概率透明度方面，中国盲盒法规的合规率相对较高，但仍有改进空间，尤其需强化对较大儿童的家长同意要求及概率披露的视觉显著性。

title: Buying blind? Physical blind boxes in China generally comply with age restrictions and are reasonably transparent

abstract: This paper develops a text-based measure of firms' climate transition risk management by constructing a dedicated dictionary and applying it to annual reports of Chinese listed firms over the period 2011–2021. Using this measure, we examine how corporate digital transformation relates to firms' management of climate transition risk. We find that digital transformation is positively associated with firms' engagement in climate transition risk management, with stronger effects for manufacturing and non-high-tech firms, and in particular for adopters of advanced digital technologies such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing and big data. To address concerns of endogeneity, we employ a staggered difference-in-differences design and propensity score matching. Moreover, our evidence shows that digital transformation is associated with observable transition-related actions, including environmental investment and green patent output. While we do not find consistent evidence that digital transformation improves short-term profitability, stronger climate transition risk management is positively associated with firm value.
abstract_zh: 本文通过构建专用词典并将其应用于2011至2021年间中国上市公司的年度报告，开发了一种基于文本的企业气候转型风险管理度量方法。利用这一度量，我们考察了企业数字化转型与气候转型风险管理之间的关系。研究发现，数字化转型与企业参与气候转型风险管理呈正相关，且这一效应在制造业及非高科技企业中更为显著，尤其是在采用人工智能、云计算和大数据等先进数字技术的企业中。为应对内生性问题，我们采用了交错双重差分设计和倾向得分匹配方法。此外，证据表明，数字化转型与可观察的转型相关行动相关联，包括环境投资和绿色专利产出。尽管我们未发现数字化转型能持续改善短期盈利能力的证据，但更强的气候转型风险管理与企业价值正相关。

title: Digital transformation and climate transition risk management: Evidence from Chinese listed firms

abstract: This study investigates the impact of corporate collaboration culture on firms' integration into global innovation networks. Using the number of firms' cross-border co-patents to measure global innovation integration, we find that the collaboration culture positively affects it. The positive effects are more pronounced for firms with lower risk-taking and higher information transparency. Moreover, the collaboration culture encourages firms to disclose more innovation-related information. These results reveal that the collaboration culture facilitates integration into global innovation networks by compensating for insufficient risk-taking and enhancing information transparency. Further analyses show that the collaboration culture improves the quality of cross-border co-patents. Strategically, firms prioritize co-patents related to the digital economy and green energy. The cooperation typically follows the pattern of Chinese applicants with foreign inventors. Taken together, these results underscore that corporate unity catalyzes longevity, enabling firms to achieve competitive endurance through integration into global innovation ecosystems.
abstract_zh: 本研究探讨了企业协作文化对企业融入全球创新网络的影响。以企业跨境合作专利数量衡量全球创新融入程度，我们发现协作文化对此产生积极影响。对于风险承担能力较低、信息透明度较高的企业，这种正面效应更为显著。此外，协作文化鼓励企业披露更多与创新相关的信息。这些结果表明，协作文化通过弥补风险承担不足和增强信息透明度，促进了企业融入全球创新网络。进一步分析显示，协作文化提升了跨境合作专利的质量。在战略层面，企业优先关注与数字经济及绿色能源相关的合作专利。合作模式通常表现为中国申请人与外国发明人相结合。综上所述，这些结果强调了企业内部的团结是持久发展的催化剂，使企业能够通过融入全球创新生态系统实现竞争耐力。

abstract: We propose a unified framework for interpreting and comparing a broad class of synthetic control (SC) methods. Our framework is built on an analysis of a mean‐squared prediction error (MSPE) bound for the counterfactual predicted by a generic SC method, without imposing a specific outcome model. Using this framework, we develop a generalized SC method that provides a more comprehensive regularization of the MSPE bound than several existing SC methods. Through simulation studies and placebo analyses, we demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in predicting the counterfactual.
abstract_zh: 本文提出一个统一框架，用于解释和比较广泛类别的合成控制（SC）方法。该框架基于对通用SC方法预测的反事实均方预测误差（MSPE）边界的分析，且无需设定特定结果模型。利用此框架，我们开发了一种广义合成控制方法，相较于现有多种SC方法，该方法对MSPE边界实现了更全面的正则化。通过模拟研究与安慰剂分析，我们验证了所提方法在反事实预测中的有效性。
title: Regularization of Synthetic Controls for Policy Evaluation
title_zh: 政策评估中合成控制法的正则化

abstract: This paper studies estimation of causal effects in a panel data setting. We introduce a new estimator, the Triply Robust Panel (TROP) estimator, that combines a flexible model for the potential outcomes based on a low‐rank factor structure on top of a two‐way‐fixed effect specification, with unit weights intended to upweight units similar to the treated units and time weights intended to upweight time periods close to the treated time periods. We study the performance of the estimator in a set of simulations designed to closely match several commonly studied real data sets. We find that there is substantial variation in the performance of the estimators across the settings considered. The proposed estimator outperforms Two‐Way‐Fixed‐Effect (TWFE) or Difference‐In‐Differences (DID), Synthetic Control (SC), Matrix Completion (MC) and Synthetic‐Difference‐In‐Differences (SDID) estimators. We investigate what features of the data generating process lead to this superior performance and assess the relative importance of the three components of the proposed estimator. We have two recommendations. Our preferred strategy is that researchers use simulations closely matched to the data they are interested in, along the lines discussed in this paper, to investigate which estimators work well in their particular setting. A simpler approach is to use more robust estimators such as SDID or the new TROP estimator, which we find to substantially outperform TWFE/DID estimators in many empirically relevant settings.
abstract_zh: 本文研究面板数据设定下的因果效应估计问题。我们提出一种新的估计量——三重稳健面板（TROP）估计量，该估计量结合了基于低秩因子结构的灵活潜在结果模型（该模型建立在双向固定效应规范之上），并引入旨在提升与处理单元相似性的单元权重，以及旨在强化接近处理时间段的时期权重。我们通过一系列与多个常用真实数据集高度匹配的模拟实验，评估该估计量的表现。研究发现，不同设定下各估计量的表现存在显著差异。所提出的估计量优于双向固定效应（TWFE）或双重差分（DID）、合成控制（SC）、矩阵补全（MC）及合成双重差分（SDID）估计量。我们进一步探究数据生成过程中哪些特征导致了这种优越表现，并评估该估计量三个组成部分的相对重要性。我们提出两项建议：首选策略是研究者应按照本文讨论的思路，针对其关注的数据进行高度匹配的模拟实验，以确定在特定设定下表现良好的估计量；更简便的方法是采用SDID或新型TROP估计量等更具稳健性的估计量，我们发现这些估计量在许多实证相关设定中显著优于TWFE/DID估计量。
title: Triply Robust Panel Estimators
title_zh: 三重稳健面板估计量

abstract: This article provides the first systematic estimates of living standards in Al‐Andalus (the Muslim‐ruled Iberian Peninsula) in 950, 1000, and 1200. Drawing on prices and wages from legal documents and market regulation treatises, it reconstructs real wages and welfare ratios. The results indicate that living standards in Al‐Andalus during the tenth century were high in both absolute and comparative terms. Unskilled workers in Córdoba around 950 and 1000 attained welfare ratios comparable to those observed in Fatimid Egypt and the poorer parts of Europe before the nineteenth century. By 1200, real wages declined, particularly for skilled labour, reflecting rising prices and stagnant nominal wages. These findings are robust to alternative basket assumptions and are consistent with independent qualitative and quantitative evidence on welfare levels, urbanization, monetary capacity, and aggregate output. The article contributes to debates on the timing of the Great Divergence by documenting another episode of high living standards under non‐Western institutions.
abstract_zh: 本文首次系统估算了安达卢斯（穆斯林统治下的伊比利亚半岛）在公元950年、1000年和1200年的生活水平。基于法律文献和市场管理论著中的价格与工资数据，本文重建了实际工资与福利比率。结果表明，10世纪安达卢斯的生活水平在绝对和比较意义上均处于高位。公元950年和1000年前后，科尔多瓦的非熟练工人所获得的福利比率，与法蒂玛王朝时期的埃及以及19世纪前欧洲较贫困地区相当。到1200年，实际工资出现下降，尤其是熟练劳动力，这反映了物价上涨与名义工资停滞。这些发现在替代性消费篮子假设下依然稳健，并与关于福利水平、城市化、货币能力及总产出的独立定性与定量证据一致。本文通过记录非西方制度下另一个高生活水平的案例，为关于“大分流”时间节点的讨论提供了新证据。
title: The Golden Age of Al‐Andalus? Living standards in Muslim Iberia (950–1200)
title_zh: 安达卢斯的黄金时代？穆斯林伊比利亚的生活水平（950–1200）

abstract: We study the market for common white bread in the city of Toledo through a new 266‐year‐long series of bread prices, obtained from the cash purchases and wholesale bread‐for‐wheat contracts of large institutions. Our data are strongly consistent with fragmentary evidence on retail price regulation, as well as with shorter series from other regional markets, suggesting they can be considered representative of consumer bread costs for a broad area of New Castile. We show that, in different periods, Toledo's bread prices were substantially lower than two common series used in the comparative literature. We also explore the role of urban institutions in stabilizing prices. We econometrically demonstrate that Toledo's wheat price fluctuations were consistent with a 1‐year storage cycle, suggesting that urban supply management systems were effective at smoothing the extreme fluctuations in early modern harvest yields. The amount of bread in a respectability basket was generally within reach of urban wage earners up to 1750. Resurgent inflation and the breakdown in regulatory institutions resulted in a marked deterioration in the affordability of bread in the second half of the eighteenth century.
abstract_zh: 本文通过大型机构现金采购和面包换小麦批发合同，构建了长达266年的托莱多市普通白面包价格序列。该数据与零售价格管制的零散证据及其他区域市场的短序列高度吻合，表明其可代表新卡斯蒂利亚广大地区消费者面包成本。研究发现，在不同时期，托莱多的面包价格显著低于比较文献中常用的两种序列。我们还探讨了城市机构在稳定价格中的作用。计量分析表明，托莱多小麦价格波动符合一年期储存周期规律，说明城市供应管理系统有效平抑了近代早期收成产量的极端波动。直至1750年，城市工薪阶层基本能负担体面生活所需的面包量。但18世纪下半叶，通胀回升与监管体系瓦解导致面包可负担性显著恶化。
title: The bread of Toledo: Prices and political economy, 1535–1800
title_zh: 托莱多的面包：价格与政治经济学，1535–1800

abstract_zh: 安东·契诃夫的小说《傻瓜》与这样一个问题相遇：“经济理论的意义是什么？
title: A ninny, an idiot and an economic theorist
title_zh: 一个傻瓜、一个白痴与一位经济理论家

abstract: Can participation in safety net programs have long-lasting negative effects across multiple generations? We take advantage of a 1993 Dutch disability insurance reform which tightened requirements and lowered benefits for participants. We study the third generation 25 years after the reform, finding that grandchildren of individuals whose DI eligibility and benefits were reduced are less likely to be born premature, have low birthweight, or experience complicated deliveries. They also have better health and schooling outcomes during early childhood. These early-life improvements are consequential, as they have been linked to better health, education, and labor market outcomes in adulthood.
abstract_zh: 参与安全网项目是否会对多代人产生长期负面影响？我们利用1993年荷兰伤残保险改革这一契机，该改革收紧了参保条件并降低了福利水平。我们研究了改革25年后的第三代群体，发现其伤残保险资格和福利被削减的个体的孙辈，早产、低出生体重或出现分娩并发症的概率更低。他们在幼儿期的健康和教育成果也更为优异。这些早期生命阶段的改善具有深远影响，因为已有研究表明其与成年后更佳的健康、教育及劳动力市场表现相关联。
title: Persistent Effects of Social Program Participation on the Third Generation
title_zh: 社会项目参与对第三代的持续影响

abstract: Forest-based solutions, such as forest landscape restoration (FLR), are increasingly emphasized in response to the interrelated crises of deforestation, biodiversity loss, and climate change. However, there is notable lack of attention to the relationship between forest governance approaches and forest transitions. In many African countries, little is known about how various forest governance models affect changes in vegetation cover over time. Leveraging remote sensing techniques and time-series analysis, we examine the changing patterns of vegetation cover from 2003 to 2021 across Malawi, where distinct governance approaches have been implemented within and across protected areas and communal lands. The analysis revealed varying patterns and magnitudes of greening (vegetation gain) and browning (vegetation loss) across different periods, seasons, locations, and scales. Our findings indicate a significant increase in greenness during 2003–2009 in districts where community-based forest management (CBFM) programs were implemented. Conversely, the extent of vegetation greening was mixed during 2005–2014 in areas where combined CBFM and forest co-management (FCoM) were the primary participatory forest governance models implemented. The FCoM governance model implemented solely during 2014–2019 was associated with very little vegetation greening. Our study offers insights into vegetation cover changes over specific timeframes, with a deeper understanding of how different participatory forest governance models have influenced these transitions. Specifically, our evidence demonstrates a positive association of CBFM with improvements in vegetation cover. This underscores the importance of strongly centering local communities in the implementation and monitoring processes of forest-based solutions, with increased power devolution, empowered self-governance authority, and stronger resource ownership rights. Consequently, an effective implementation of Malawi's FLR strategy should prioritize institutional models that fully devolve power to local community with adequate means for self-governance while granting secure resource rights. However, additional factors that would sustain observed greening outcomes require further investigation using modeling approaches.
abstract_zh: 基于森林的解决方案，如森林景观恢复（FLR），正日益受到重视，以应对森林砍伐、生物多样性丧失和气候变化这三重相互关联的危机。然而，森林治理方法与森林转型之间的关系却明显缺乏关注。在许多非洲国家，不同森林治理模式如何影响植被覆盖随时间的变化，人们知之甚少。利用遥感技术和时间序列分析，我们考察了2003年至2021年间马拉维植被覆盖的变化模式，该国在保护区和社区土地内外实施了不同的治理方法。分析揭示了不同时期、季节、地点和尺度上绿化（植被增加）和褐化（植被减少）的不同模式和程度。我们的研究结果表明，在实施社区森林管理（CBFM）项目的地区，2003年至2009年间绿度显著增加。相反，在2005年至2014年间，以CBFM和森林共同管理（FCoM）为主要参与式森林治理模式的地区，植被绿化的程度参差不齐。仅在2014年至2019年间实施的FCoM治理模式与极少的植被绿化相关。我们的研究提供了特定时间框架内植被覆盖变化的见解，并深入理解了不同参与式森林治理模式如何影响这些转型。具体而言，我们的证据表明CBFM与植被覆盖改善之间存在正相关关系。这强调了在森林解决方案的实施和监测过程中，以地方社区为核心的重要性，包括增加权力下放、增强自治权以及强化资源所有权。因此，有效实施马拉维的FLR战略应优先考虑将权力完全下放给地方社区、提供充分自治手段并保障资源权利的体制模式。然而，维持所观察到的绿化成果的其他因素仍需通过建模方法进一步研究。
title: Spatio-temporal analysis of vegetation cover transitions and underlying governance approaches in Malawi, Southern Africa
title_zh: 马拉维南部非洲植被覆盖变化及其治理方式的时空分析

abstract: This paper considers time domain estimation of possibly non-fundamental (that is, non-causal and/or non-invertible) non-Gaussian linear ARMA models with martingale difference innovations that may display conditional heteroskedasticity of unknown form. Instead of explicitly parametrizing the underlying volatility process (the higher order dependence) and employing maximum likelihood procedures, we propose a time domain minimum distance objective function based on innovations predictability using second and third powers of past innovations. Using the proposed efficient GMM estimator, which is consistent and asymptotically normal, we estimate possibly non-fundamental ARMA models to inflation data from 29 OECD countries and find widespread evidence on non-fundamentalness.
abstract_zh: 本文探讨了在可能非基础（即非因果和/或非可逆）的非高斯线性ARMA模型中进行时域估计的问题，这些模型具有鞅差创新，可能表现出未知形式的条件异方差性。我们并未明确参数化潜在的波动率过程（高阶依赖性）并采用最大似然方法，而是提出了一种基于过去创新二次和三次幂的可预测性的时域最小距离目标函数。利用所提出的有效GMM估计量，该估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性，我们对29个OECD国家的通胀数据估计了可能非基础的ARMA模型，并发现了非基础性的广泛证据。
source_issue: Journal of Econometrics, Volume 256, Part A
title: Time domain estimation of non-fundamental ARMA models in the presence of heteroskedasticity of unknown form
title_zh: 异方差形式未知时非基础ARMA模型的时域估计

abstract: Many topics in the behavioral sciences and epidemiology require researchers to directly observe entities (e.g., individuals, households) over a long time to identify lasting effects. Long-term panel data collection is more common in high-income countries than in small-scale rural societies (SSRS) of low-income countries. SSRS are mobile, nature-dependent, linguistic minorities, and highly autarkic. Analyzing such data using a life-course perspective can help uncover patterns that align or upend what we know from high-income countries. This study a) reviews long (>∼10 year) panels in SSRS (n = 9), b) extends the analysis to cover somewhat comparable societies of smallholders (n = 7) who are less autarkic, and c) draws on annual panel data (2002–2010) from one SSRS in the Bolivian Amazon (Tsimane’) to illustrate how adult life-course patterns may vary but also resemble patterns in high-income countries. In general, panels have focused more on human biology than on socioeconomic outcomes, have gathered data at irregular intervals, and have not deposited datasets in public repositories. Compared with people in high-income countries, Tsimane’ were similar in the amount of intragenerational immobility at the very top and the very bottom of the income and wealth distribution. In both places, body weight rose while sociality frayed over time. Yet Tsimane’ differed in having more economic mobility outside the top and bottom income and wealth distribution, a slightly higher growth rate in economic inequality, and no correlation between economic mobility and age. We identify institutional and individual hurdles to collecting panel data in SSRS and discuss steps to overcome them.
abstract_zh: 行为科学与流行病学中的许多议题要求研究者长期直接观察实体（如个体、家庭）以识别持久效应。长期面板数据的收集在高收入国家比在低收入国家的小规模农村社会（SSRS）更为普遍。SSRS具有流动性强、依赖自然、语言少数群体及高度自给自足的特点。运用生命历程视角分析此类数据，有助于揭示与高收入国家已知模式相符或相悖的规律。本研究a）回顾了SSRS中长期（约>10年）面板研究（n=9），b）将分析扩展至较为相似但自给程度较低的小农社会（n=7），c）利用玻利维亚亚马逊地区Tsimane’人（2002-2010年）的年度面板数据，说明成人生命历程模式可能存在的差异及其与高收入国家模式的相似之处。总体而言，这些面板研究更侧重于人类生物学而非社会经济结果，数据收集间隔不规律，且未将数据集存入公共存储库。与高收入国家人群相比，Tsimane’人在收入和财富分布的最顶端及最底端表现出相似的代内流动性缺失程度。两地均出现体重增加而社会交往随时间减少的现象。然而，Tsimane’人的不同之处在于，在收入和财富分布顶端与底端之外存在更高的经济流动性，经济不平等增长率略高，且经济流动性与年龄之间无相关性。我们识别了在SSRS中收集面板数据的制度性和个体性障碍，并讨论了克服这些障碍的步骤。
title: Long panel studies of small-scale rural societies in the Global South: What is their value, why are they rare, and suggestions to make them happen
title_zh: 全球南方小规模农村社会的长期面板研究：其价值、稀缺原因及推进建议

abstract: To what extent do strategic trade-related considerations influence the European Union’s allocation of climate aid? As a major climate aid donor and a global trade power, the EU has frequently been shown to prioritize economic interests, particularly those of its export-oriented industries, in its external actions. This paper investigates whether trade influences EU climate aid allocation and, if so, whether this effect reflects strategic efforts to enhance trade or is simply a byproduct of established ties and familiarity with trade partners. Using disaggregate, sector-level data on both climate aid and trade flows, we assess whether the EU directs aid towards sectors that serve trade interests, especially those where its export stakes are high. Results from two-part regression models provide mixed evidence regarding strategic allocation: On the one hand, the EU consistently favors sectors linked to its export interests in climate aid allocation; on the other hand, trade interests play only a modest role in shaping other aspects of that allocation. Beyond the EU case, the paper contributes to the broader literature on (climate) aid allocation and its links to trade, offering insight into the mechanisms that may shape this relationship.
abstract_zh: 战略性贸易考量在多大程度上影响欧盟的气候援助分配？作为主要的气候援助捐助方和全球贸易大国，欧盟的外部行动常被指出优先考虑经济利益，尤其是其出口导向型产业的经济利益。本文探讨贸易是否影响欧盟的气候援助分配，若确有影响，这种效应是反映了旨在促进贸易的战略性努力，还是仅仅是既有联系及对贸易伙伴熟悉程度的副产品。利用气候援助和贸易流量的分部门、部门级数据，我们评估欧盟是否将援助导向服务于贸易利益的部门，特别是其出口利益较高的部门。两部分回归模型的结果为战略性分配提供了混合证据：一方面，欧盟在气候援助分配中始终偏向与其出口利益相关的部门；另一方面，贸易利益在塑造该分配的其他方面仅发挥有限作用。除欧盟案例外，本文还对更广泛的（气候）援助分配及其与贸易联系的文献有所贡献，为可能塑造这一关系的机制提供了洞见。
title: EU climate aid and trade interests: strategy or byproduct of closer ties?
title_zh: 欧盟气候援助与贸易利益：战略还是关系深化的副产品？

abstract: Brazil’s Pacifying Police Units (UPPs) were an incremental police reform project implemented in Rio de Janeiro in 2008. Though initially celebrated as an innovate approach for reducing police violence, the project did not produce substantive changes in the structure of local police forces, their violent practices, or the state’s historically poor public security outcomes. It has since been characterized as a failed reform, suggesting that some scholars’ early skepticism was warranted. This paper revisits the initial enthusiasm in light of these disappointing results and draws on recent empirical research to assess what specific lessons can be taken from the UPP experience. We argue that the initiative’s failure can be traced back to three main factors: temporality (how fast the project expanded), governance (how independent the project was from the existing police institutions), and scope of the reform (how structural were the changes proposed). These shortcomings hindered the UPPs ability to innovate and overcome internal resistance to change. We suggest these dynamics may offer insights applicable to other institutional reforms.
abstract_zh: 巴西的维和警察单位（UPPs）是2008年在里约热内卢实施的一项渐进式警察改革项目。尽管最初被誉为减少警察暴力的创新方法，该项目并未在地方警察部队的结构、其暴力行为或国家历史上糟糕的公共安全成果方面产生实质性变化。此后，该项目被定性为失败的改革，这表明一些学者早期的怀疑是有道理的。本文基于这些令人失望的结果重新审视了最初的热情，并借鉴近期的实证研究来评估从UPP经验中可以汲取哪些具体教训。我们认为，该倡议的失败可追溯至三个主要因素：时间性（项目扩张的速度）、治理（项目与现有警察机构的独立性）以及改革范围（所提议变革的结构性程度）。这些缺陷阻碍了UPPs创新及克服内部变革阻力的能力。我们提出，这些动态可能为其他制度改革提供可借鉴的见解。
title: Brazil’s pacifying police units revisited: A failed democratic policing project and lessons for institutional reforms
title_zh: 巴西安抚警察部队再审视：一项失败的民主警务计划及其对制度改革的启示

abstract: Can governments use real bonds such as Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities (TIPS) to tame inflation? We propose a novel framework of optimal debt management with sticky prices and a government issuing nominal and real state-uncontingent bonds. A government debt portfolio with both nominal and real bonds helps completing markets unless the monetary policy stance renders them perfect substitutes. Under Full Commitment, the government borrows with nominal debt and accumulates real assets, to be able to use inflation to smooth taxes. With No Commitment, the government portfolio favors real bonds to strategically prevent future governments from monetizing debt ex-post. Quantitatively, our model with No Commitment is consistent with the small and persistent TIPS share in U.S. data. A higher TIPS share mitigates the commitment friction, and effectively curbs inflation.
abstract_zh: 政府能否利用实际债券（如通货膨胀保值国债，TIPS）来抑制通胀？我们提出一个新颖的最优债务管理框架，其中包含价格粘性，且政府发行名义和实际的无状态或有债券。包含名义与实际债券的政府债务组合有助于完善市场，除非货币政策立场使它们成为完全替代品。在完全承诺下，政府通过名义债务借款并积累实际资产，以便利用通胀来平滑税收。在无承诺情况下，政府组合倾向于实际债券，以策略性地防止未来政府事后将债务货币化。定量分析显示，我们的无承诺模型与美国数据中小而持久的TIPS份额相符。更高的TIPS份额缓解了承诺摩擦，并有效遏制了通胀。
title: Government debt management and inflation with real and nominal bonds
title_zh: 实际与名义债券下的政府债务管理与通胀

abstract: Using one million procurement contracts awarded in France and Spain, we quantify the importance of home bias in explaining governments’ purchases. First, we exploit that “home” has a different meaning for subnational and national governments and identify their relative home bias by comparing how local and non-local establishments sell to national and subnational agencies within a region. Second, we exploit a reorganization of French regions, to estimate how “new local” establishments sell to governments after the reform. Using a quantitative trade model, we find that governments’ home bias increases local expenditures shares by 29% and reduces governments’ output by 8%.
abstract_zh: 利用法国和西班牙授予的一百万份采购合同，我们量化了本土偏好对政府购买行为的重要性。首先，我们利用“本土”对次国家级和国家级政府的不同含义，通过比较区域内本地与非本地企业向国家和次国家级机构销售的情况，识别出它们的相对本土偏好。其次，我们利用法国地区的重组，估计了改革后“新本地”企业如何向政府销售。借助定量贸易模型，我们发现政府的本土偏好使本地支出份额增加了29%，同时使政府产出减少了8%。
title: Governments’ home bias and efficiency losses: Evidence from national and subnational governments
title_zh: 政府本土偏好与效率损失：来自国家及地方政府的证据

abstract: A long-standing question in health economics asks what drives heterogeneity in health investments across sociodemographic groups, which contribute to health disparities. We examine a novel source: variation by sociodemographic groups in the impact of medical treatment side effects. We estimate a lifecycle model of medication and labor supply decisions using data on men infected with human immunodeficiency virus (HIV) and with different levels of completed education. Agents in the model make dynamic medication and work choices as a function of expected income, health, and mortality. We also include utility costs of side effects, which can interact with the utility cost of work, and allow these parameters to vary by education. We use the estimated model to evaluate the disparate impacts of an effective HIV treatment innovation that had harsh side effects: HAART (which stands for highly active antiretroviral treatment). Measured in lifetime utility gains, HAART disproportionately benefited patients with more education in part due to differences in income and mortality, but also due to smaller impacts of side effects on labor supply. We also simulate the effects of a HAART treatment mandate, which mimics assignment to treatment in a clinical trial. The mandate improves health, which might be viewed as a success in a randomized trial. However, this masks the downsides of treatment, including lower labor supply due to side effects, especially for lower-education men. Broadly, viewing heterogeneity in health investments as solely a result of barriers to access is overly simplistic. Individually optimal investments in health may in part reflect the costs of managing side effects and work. If low health investments create negative externalities (e.g., due to increased use of publicly-funded healthcare), the benefits of policies that moderate resulting health-work tradeoffs could outweigh the costs.
abstract_zh: 健康经济学中一个长期存在的问题是，什么因素导致了不同社会人口群体在健康投资上的异质性，这种异质性进而加剧了健康差距。我们考察了一个新的来源：社会人口群体在医疗治疗副作用影响上的差异。我们利用感染人类免疫缺陷病毒（HIV）且教育程度不同的男性数据，估计了一个关于服药和劳动供给决策的生命周期模型。模型中的个体根据预期收入、健康状况和死亡率做出动态的服药与工作选择。我们还将副作用的效用成本纳入模型，这些成本可能与工作的效用成本相互作用，并允许这些参数因教育程度而异。我们利用估计的模型评估了一种具有严重副作用的有效HIV治疗创新——HAART（即高效抗逆转录病毒治疗）——对不同群体的差异化影响。以终身效用增益衡量，HAART不成比例地惠及教育程度较高的患者，部分原因在于收入和死亡率的差异，但也因为副作用对劳动供给的影响较小。我们还模拟了HAART治疗强制实施的效果，这类似于临床试验中的治疗分配。强制实施改善了健康状况，这在随机试验中可能被视为成功。然而，这掩盖了治疗的负面影响，包括因副作用导致的劳动供给下降，尤其是对教育程度较低的男性而言。总体来看，将健康投资的异质性仅仅视为获取障碍的结果是过于简单化的。个体最优的健康投资可能部分反映了管理副作用和工作的成本。如果低健康投资产生负外部性（例如，由于公共资助医疗服务的增加使用），那么调节由此产生的健康与工作权衡的政策的收益可能超过其成本。
title: Medical innovation and health disparities
title_zh: 医学创新与健康差距

abstract: We estimate the causal effect of ride-hailing entry on transport-related air pollution, disentangling its mediating effect through changes in commuting modes in U.S. cities. To do so, we combine two sets of empirical approaches. First, for our main outcome regression, we leverage granular satellite-based NO2 concentration data and a newly constructed Google Trends-based measure of ride-hailing presence, with the staggered difference-in-differences design. Second, to explore its mediating mechanism, we use household-level commuting mode data to run two auxiliary regressions: commuting modes on ride-hailing entry and ambient NO2 concentration on commuting modes. For identification on the latter, we construct our instruments by combining geography-based instruments with leave-one-out regional average exposure to Uber’s official entry. We find robust evidence that (i) ride-hailing improves air quality in highly dense cities, but has no significant impact in cities with low to medium density and (ii) this air quality improvement is indeed mediated by the associated changes in commuting mode choices. Our findings provide strong empirical support for the hypothesis that the environmental impact of ride-hailing depends on its complementarity with public transit.
abstract_zh: 我们估算了网约车进入对交通相关空气污染的因果效应，并分解了其通过美国城市通勤方式变化产生的中介效应。为此，我们结合了两套实证方法。首先，对于主要结果回归，我们利用基于卫星的高分辨率二氧化氮浓度数据和新构建的基于谷歌趋势的网约车存在度指标，采用交错双重差分设计。其次，为探究其中介机制，我们使用家庭层面的通勤方式数据进行了两项辅助回归：通勤方式对网约车进入的回归，以及环境二氧化氮浓度对通勤方式的回归。为识别后者，我们通过结合基于地理的工具变量与留一法区域平均优步官方进入暴露度来构建工具变量。我们发现了稳健的证据表明：（i）网约车改善了高密度城市的空气质量，但对低至中等密度城市无显著影响；（ii）这种空气质量改善确实由相关的通勤方式选择变化所中介。我们的发现为以下假设提供了强有力的实证支持：网约车的环境影响取决于其与公共交通的互补性。
title: Is ride-sharing good for environment? Evidence from combining satellite and survey data on U.S. cities
title_zh: 拼车对环境有益吗？基于美国城市卫星与调查数据的证据

abstract: This paper examines how precipitation shocks affect poverty in Ecuador. Using gridded monthly precipitation data for 2007-2024, we construct parish-level measures of excess and deficit precipitation and link them to household socioeconomic data from the National Survey of Employment, Unemployment, and Underemployment (ENEMDU). Our empirical estimates show that both excess and deficit precipitation increase the likelihood of poverty among workers in the primary sector (agriculture and mining), consistent with disruptions to agricultural production and local infrastructure. By contrast, in the tertiary sector (commerce and services), precipitation shocks lower the probability of poverty, plausibly reflecting heightened demand for health and social assistance, transportation, logistics, and related services during emergency response and recovery phases. We identify per-capita labor income and per-capita final household income as primary transmission channels, with magnitudes conditioned by formality status, location (urban versus rural), self-employment, and the recurrence of shocks. These findings underscore the potential of targeted sector-specific policies to mitigate the poverty impacts of weather shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了降水冲击如何影响厄瓜多尔的贫困状况。利用2007-2024年网格化月降水数据，我们构建了教区层面的过度降水与降水不足指标，并将其与全国就业、失业与不充分就业调查（ENEMDU）中的家庭社会经济数据相关联。实证估计显示，过度降水与降水不足均增加了第一产业（农业与采矿业）从业者陷入贫困的可能性，这与农业生产及当地基础设施受到干扰的情况相符。相比之下，在第三产业（商业与服务业），降水冲击降低了贫困概率，这很可能反映了在应急响应与恢复阶段，对健康与社会援助、交通、物流及相关服务需求的增加。我们识别出人均劳动收入与人均最终家庭收入为主要传导渠道，其影响程度受正规就业状态、地理位置（城市与农村）、自雇状态及冲击反复发生情况的调节。这些发现凸显了针对特定部门制定政策以减轻天气冲击对贫困影响的潜力。
title: Here comes the rain: Precipitation shocks and economic outcomes in Ecuador
title_zh: 降雨来袭：厄瓜多尔的降水冲击与经济产出

abstract: We examine the impact of lost intellectual property protection on innovation, competition, firm performance, and valuation. We consider firms whose ability to protect intellectual property (IP) using patents is weakened following a major Supreme Court decision. We use large language models (LLM) to identify firms’ patent portfolios’ exposure to this decision and find an unequal impact. Large firms gain and small firms lose. Large impacted firms benefit as their sales growth increases and their exposure to lawsuits decreases. Small impacted firms lose as they face increased competition, product-market encroachment, and lower profits and valuations. They increase R&D and nondisclosure agreements.
abstract_zh: 我们研究了知识产权保护丧失对创新、竞争、企业绩效及估值的影响。我们关注那些因最高法院一项重大裁决而专利保护能力被削弱的企业。利用大型语言模型（LLM）识别企业专利组合受该裁决影响的程度，我们发现影响并不均衡：大企业受益，小企业受损。受影响的大企业因销售增长加快和诉讼风险降低而获益；受影响的小企业则因竞争加剧、产品市场被侵占以及利润和估值下降而受损，它们增加了研发投入并加强了保密协议的使用。
title: Intellectual property protection lost and competition: An examination using large language models
title_zh: 知识产权保护缺失与竞争：基于大语言模型的检验

abstract: We study the effect of prudence on optimal prevention in two periods with Kreps and Porteus (1978) and Selden (1978) (KPS) preferences. We use consumption smoothing as the benchmark and consider risk-averse decision-makers. In this framework, prudence has a positive effect on prevention, generalizing findings of Menegatti (2009). We extend this result to risk lovers and comparative risk aversion. When saving is endogenized, the preference over the timing of uncertainty resolution becomes irrelevant for prevention, and only the curvature of marginal utility matters. This result allows us to identify a class of decision-makers who are prudent in the KPS model but whose prevention effort coincides with that of a risk-neutral agent. Our findings highlight that the structure of intertemporal preferences critically shapes the link between prudence and prevention.
abstract_zh: 本文研究在Kreps与Porteus（1978）及Selden（1978）（KPS）偏好框架下，审慎性对两期最优预防行为的影响。以消费平滑为基准，我们考察风险厌恶型决策者。在此框架中，审慎性对预防行为具有正向促进作用，从而推广了Menegatti（2009）的研究结论。我们将该结论拓展至风险偏好型决策者及比较风险厌恶情形。当储蓄内生化时，不确定性解决的时间偏好对预防行为不再具有影响，仅边际效用曲率发挥作用。这一发现使我们能够识别出KPS模型中具有审慎性、但其预防努力水平与风险中性主体一致的决策者群体。研究结果凸显跨期偏好结构对审慎性与预防行为关联性的关键塑造作用。
publisher: Springer Science and Business Media LLC
title: Disentangling risk and time for optimal prevention
title_zh: 分离风险与时间以实现最优预防
